name: Nigerian Navy
shortDescription: Strategic partnership for maritime security and training opportunities.
fullDescription: The Nigerian Navy supports Fountain University's maritime security education and provides opportunities for cadet training, research collaboration, and national service awareness.

shortDescription: Academic collaboration with a sister Islamic university in Nigeria.

name: INTI International University, Malaysia
shortDescription: Global academic link supporting student exchange and programme benchmarking.
fullDescription:
In 2023, Fountain University entered into a strategic academic partnership with INTI International University, Malaysia, further advancing its vision of internationalization and global academic engagement. The collaboration was established through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) designed to promote academic excellence, research collaboration, and cross-cultural learning through a broad range of mutually beneficial initiatives.

The partnership provides a platform for student and staff mobility programmes, visiting scholar exchanges, collaborative research, joint publications, curriculum development, and the exchange of academic resources and best practices. It also encourages the joint organization of international conferences, seminars, workshops, and specialized training programmes that foster intellectual exchange and strengthen research capacity across both institutions.

Beyond institutional collaboration, the partnership enriches the academic experience of students and staff by providing opportunities for international exposure, intercultural learning, and participation in global research networks. It enables members of the University community to engage with diverse perspectives, explore emerging fields of knowledge, and build lasting professional relationships with scholars across continents.

A distinctive feature of the partnership is the shared commitment of both institutions to safeguarding the interests of students by ensuring continuity of any ongoing academic programmes throughout the duration of the collaboration.

Through this partnership, Fountain University continues to strengthen its international profile, broaden opportunities for global engagement, and prepare graduates with the knowledge, skills, and global outlook required to excel in an increasingly interconnected world.

name: Association of West African Universities (AWAU)
shortDescription: Regional consortium for academic collaboration and capacity building.
fullDescription:
As part of its commitment to regional academic integration and internationalization, Fountain University became a member of the Association of West African Universities (AWAU) in 2024. The Association promotes inter-university collaboration, academic excellence, quality assurance, research development, and institutional advancement across West Africa.

The University's active participation in AWAU activities has further strengthened its regional academic presence. The Vice-Chancellor, Professor Olayinka Ramota Karim, accompanied by Dr. Ahmad Agbaje of the Department of Arabic and Islamic Studies, represented Fountain University at the 10th Annual Conference and 12th Annual General Meeting, held in Senegal from 19–22 February 2025. The conference, themed "Artificial Intelligence, Multidisciplinary Research and Regional Integration," provided a platform for universities across the region to explore emerging trends shaping higher education.

Fountain University's engagement continued at the Association's subsequent conference in Sierra Leone, where the Vice-Chancellor chaired one of the technical sessions, while Dr. Rasheed Adebiyi presented a scholarly paper entitled "Innovation Hubs as Engines for Quality-Assured Research: Examples from Fountain University, Osogbo, Nigeria."

Through its active participation in AWAU, Fountain University continues to contribute meaningfully to regional scholarship, research collaboration, and higher education development while positioning itself as a leading institution responding to emerging global challenges.

name: Association of African Universities
shortDescription: Pan-African network advancing university collaboration across the continent.
fullDescription:
In 2025, Fountain University attained full membership of the Association of African Universities (AAU), the premier continental organization dedicated to advancing higher education in Africa.

Membership of the AAU provides the University with expanded opportunities for international collaboration in research, innovation, quality assurance, postgraduate education, policy advocacy, staff development, and institutional capacity building.

Through this prestigious affiliation, Fountain University joins a distinguished network of African universities committed to promoting academic excellence, strengthening research capacity, facilitating student and staff mobility, harmonising academic standards, and addressing Africa's developmental challenges through collective action and knowledge exchange.

The membership further reinforces the University's vision of becoming a globally recognized institution distinguished by academic excellence, innovation, and impactful research.

name: TReND in Africa
shortDescription: Research and training collaboration in science education.
fullDescription:
In 2023, Fountain University entered into a landmark strategic partnership with Teaching and Research in Natural Sciences for Development in Africa (TReND in Africa), a United Kingdom-based, volunteer-driven non-profit organization dedicated to strengthening scientific research and innovation across Africa.

The collaboration, formalized through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), was established with the University's Molecular Biology and Genetic Diversity Laboratory (MBGD-FUO) to enhance research capacity in molecular biology, biotechnology, and biomedical sciences.

As part of the partnership, TReND in Africa provided the University with state-of-the-art scientific equipment on a long-term loan basis, significantly enhancing the laboratory's capacity for advanced molecular research, including recombinant DNA technology, molecular diagnostics, advanced microscopy, and cervical cancer research.

A major milestone of the collaboration was the establishment of advanced research facilities equipped with sophisticated instruments, including a Confocal Microscope, which has greatly strengthened the University's research capability in biomedical sciences.

The partnership also facilitated an intensive capacity-building workshop on Molecular Diagnostic Techniques and Advanced Microscopy, attended by more than 120 researchers, academics, postgraduate students, laboratory scientists, and early-career scientists from across Nigeria and beyond.

Beyond infrastructure support, the collaboration integrates Fountain University into an expanding continental network of scientists committed to advancing research excellence in Africa. It provides opportunities for collaborative research, mentorship, technical training, international networking, and knowledge exchange, thereby empowering staff and students to undertake cutting-edge research capable of addressing pressing health and developmental challenges.

This partnership reflects Fountain University's commitment to building a globally competitive research ecosystem that contributes meaningfully to scientific discovery, innovation, and sustainable development.

name: University of Cambridge
shortDescription: Global academic link to a leading research university.
fullDescription:
One of Fountain University's most significant international research achievements is its collaboration with the University of Cambridge, United Kingdom, aimed at addressing one of Nigeria's critical public health challenges—early detection and prevention of cervical cancer.

In 2024, Professor Nusrah Bolatito Afolabi-Balogun of the Department of Chemical Sciences, Fountain University, in collaboration with Dr. Sara Pensa of the University of Cambridge, secured the highly competitive Cambridge-Africa Alborada Research Fund to undertake an innovative research project focused on developing reliable, accessible, and affordable approaches for the early diagnosis of cervical cancer in Nigeria.

The collaboration has significantly strengthened Fountain University's biomedical research capacity. Through the first phase of the project, the University received advanced medical research equipment valued at over ₦150 million, greatly enhancing the capabilities of its Molecular Biology and Genetic Diversity Laboratory for cutting-edge biomedical and molecular research.

Building on this success, the research team commenced extensive community-based activities in September 2024, providing free cervical cancer screening, Pap smear testing, Human Papillomavirus (HPV) genotyping, and comprehensive health education to more than 600 women across several communities in Osun State.

By integrating advanced molecular diagnostic technologies with community outreach, the project has improved access to life-saving early detection services for both rural and urban populations while contributing to public awareness on cervical cancer prevention and women's health.

The collaboration has also delivered substantial capacity-building benefits. More than 40 researchers, postgraduate students, healthcare professionals, laboratory scientists, and early-career researchers received specialized training in Molecular Diagnostic Techniques and Advanced Microscopy, facilitated through the University's newly equipped Molecular Biology and Genetic Diversity Laboratory.

A major highlight of the project was the deployment of a state-of-the-art Confocal Microscope, acquired through the equipment donation programme of Teaching and Research in Natural Sciences for Development in Africa (TReND in Africa). The equipment has significantly expanded the University's capacity for advanced biomedical research, diagnostics, and postgraduate training.

Describing the project, the Vice-Chancellor, Professor Olayinka Ramota Karim, noted that the collaboration exemplifies the transformative power of international research partnerships in addressing pressing societal challenges while simultaneously strengthening institutional research capacity, improving public health outcomes, and creating meaningful learning opportunities for students and researchers.

This landmark collaboration reflects Fountain University's growing reputation as a globally connected research institution committed to scientific innovation, community impact, and the advancement of knowledge for sustainable development.

name: African Alborada
shortDescription: Research collaboration for social impact studies.
fullDescription: African Alborada partners with Fountain University on research projects that explore social development, applied science, and community innovation in Nigeria.

name: Consortium of Islamic Faith-Based Universities
shortDescription: Network of faith-based universities collaborating on shared values and scholarship.
fullDescription:
One of Fountain University's most significant contributions to higher education in Nigeria is the initiation of the Consortium of Islamic Faith-Based Universities.

In 2023, under the visionary leadership of the Vice-Chancellor, Professor Olayinka Ramota Karim, the University spearheaded the establishment of the Consortium, bringing together six pioneer institutions:
• Fountain University, Osogbo
• Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin
• Crescent University, Abeokuta
• Summit University, Offa
• Muhammad Kamalud-deen University, Ilorin
• Minaret University, Ikirun

The Consortium was established to promote collaborative research, academic partnerships, staff and student exchange programmes, resource sharing, curriculum development, and innovation among Islamic faith-based universities.

Fountain University hosted the Maiden International Conference of the Consortium from 1–2 July 2025 at its Osogbo campus. The conference, themed "Bridging Faith, Knowledge, and Innovation for Sustainable Development," attracted over 300 participants and featured 107 peer-reviewed research abstracts from more than 20 higher institutions.

A landmark achievement of the conference was the unanimous resolution to expand the Consortium into a national body, now known as the Consortium of Islamic Faith-Based Universities in Nigeria, thereby opening membership to Islamic faith-based universities across the country.

This initiative underscores Fountain University's leadership in fostering collaboration, advancing Islamic scholarship, promoting research excellence, and contributing to sustainable development in higher education.

COMMUNIQUÉ ISSUED AT THE END OF THE MAIDEN CONFERENCE OF THE CONSORTIUM OF ISLAMIC FAITH-BASED UNIVERSITIES IN KWARA STATE AND SOUTHWEST NIGERIA

1.0 Preamble

The maiden Conference of the Consortium of Islamic Faith-Based Universities in Southwest and Kwara States was held at Fountain University, Osogbo, Osun State, from Tuesday, July 1st to Wednesday, July 2nd, 2025 (6–7 Muharram, 1447 AH). The event was chaired by Alhaja Kafilat Araoye, MD/CEO of LOTUS Bank Nigeria, whose attendance and remarks reaffirmed the vital role of Islamic principles in corporate leadership and long-term economic sustainability.

The opening ceremony, held at the Eti-Osa Lecture Theatre, drew over 300 attendees, including 116 registered participants from various Nigerian higher education institutions. The conference theme, "Bridging Faith, Knowledge, and Innovation for Sustainable Development", captured the Consortium's core vision—first conceived by Fountain University in 2023—to foster academic cooperation, moral integrity, and community-driven innovation among Islamic faith-based universities.

Currently, the Consortium comprises six institutions: Fountain University, Al-Hikmah University, Summit University, Muhammad Kamalud-deen University, Minaret University, and Crescent University. The Chairperson of the Consortium and Vice-Chancellor of Fountain University, Prof. Olayinka Ramota Karim, in her address, emphasized the need for collaboration, inclusive growth, and the avoidance of unhealthy competition. All participating Vice-Chancellors declared their full support and shared goodwill messages.

The keynote address was delivered by Prof. Wahab Egbewole, SAN, Vice-Chancellor of the University of Ilorin. He underlined the importance of aligning education with spiritual values to foster a just and sustainable society, drawing from the rich legacy of Islamic scholarship. The lead paper by Dr. Nasiru Onibon focused on "Faith, Ethics, and Leadership: Reimagining Higher Education Institution Effectiveness", challenging Islamic institutions to drive transformation through moral leadership and ethical governance.

2.0 Observations

Participants observed the following:
1. The global socio-economic and technological transformations demand an ethical, inclusive, and sustainable development approach—one that Islamic principles are well-positioned to provide.
2. Faith-based ethical frameworks are increasingly relevant in addressing issues such as multi-dimensional poverty, limited educational access, environmental degradation, and economic instability.
3. The Consortium aims to harness the intersections of faith, knowledge, and innovation to support Nigeria's sustainable development goals.

A total of 108 abstracts were submitted and peer-reviewed, leading to five technical sessions under the following sub-themes:
1. Education, Language, and Cultural Integration in Nation Building
2. Media, Communication, and the Role of Faith in a Digital Era
3. Law, Governance, and Social Justice in a Multicultural Society
4. Entrepreneurship, Business, and Economic Development
5. Science, Technology, and Innovation for Sustainable Development

3.0 Resolutions

At the end of the technical and plenary sessions, participants unanimously resolved that:
1) That the Consortium of Islamic Faith-Based Universities be expanded to the national level to reflect broader participation and impact. Consequently, the nomenclature shall henceforth be: "The Consortium of Islamic Faith-Based Universities in Nigeria."
2) That faith-based institutions can significantly reshape higher education in Nigeria by integrating scientific innovation with spiritual values, and making ethics, justice, leadership, and entrepreneurship central to their strategies and curricula.
3) That member universities should collaborate on research, share facilities and resources, and actively engage in policy discourse, intellectual exchange, and ethical leadership training for both students and staff.
4) That research and development efforts should prioritize media literacy, digital proficiency, environmental stewardship, and the ethical use of emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, to enhance learning and innovation.
5) That institutions must work toward inclusive access to quality education and provide faith-aligned, practical solutions to the challenges facing their host communities and the broader society.

4.0 Acknowledgement

The participants expressed deep appreciation to Fountain University for hosting the historic event and commended the Vice-Chancellor, Prof. Olayinka Ramota Karim, for her visionary leadership, commitment to faith-based scholarship, and dedication to institutional advancement.

The conference concluded with renewed resolve among delegates to champion faith-inspired innovation, institutional collaboration, and transformative education for national and global impact.

Signed: Prof. A.T. Lawal, Chairman, Local Organizing Committee

fullDescription: NMI supports Fountain University's institutional development through industry-aligned programmes, training resources, and collaborative advisory services.

shortDescription: Clinical partnership for health sciences training and placements.
fullDescription: The hospital provides clinical placement opportunities for Fountain University health science students and supports applied research in healthcare practice.

name: Cisco Academy
shortDescription: Technology training partnership with global networking education.
fullDescription:
As part of its commitment to preparing graduates for the digital economy, Fountain University has significantly expanded opportunities for internationally recognized professional certification through strategic partnerships in digital technology and information systems.

Through the Fountain University Centre for Research, Innovation and Technology (FUCRIT), the University launched a comprehensive digital skills development initiative in collaboration with the Cisco Networking Academy.

The initiative commenced with a five-day Train-the-Trainer Programme held in March 2025, during which academic staff from different Colleges received professional training and certification as Cisco instructors. This decentralized model enabled digital skills training to be integrated across all Colleges, making globally recognized ICT education accessible to students irrespective of their disciplines.

Building on this success, Fountain University signed a Memorandum of Understanding with DAVETEM EDU AID CONCEPT in April 2026 for the implementation of the Microsoft 21st Century Skills International Certification Programme.

Training under the Microsoft programme commenced in May 2026, providing students with practical competencies in Microsoft productivity applications, digital literacy, workplace technologies, and emerging digital skills required in today's knowledge economy.

Collectively, the Cisco and Microsoft certification programmes enrolled students from all Colleges of the University, equipping them with internationally recognized certifications in networking, information technology, digital productivity, and workplace technologies.

To institutionalize these initiatives and ensure their long-term sustainability, Fountain University established a Professional Certification Coordination Office, responsible for coordinating globally recognized certification programmes, expanding industry partnerships, and increasing access to professional qualifications for students and staff.

These initiatives reaffirm Fountain University's commitment to producing digitally competent graduates who possess the technological knowledge, professional certifications, and twenty-first-century skills required to thrive in an increasingly digital and globally competitive workplace.

name: RUDN University
shortDescription: Research and academic exchange with a global partner in Russia.
fullDescription:
Fountain University has continued to expand its global academic footprint through a thriving partnership with RUDN University (Peoples' Friendship University of Russia), Moscow, one of Russia's leading international universities.

The collaboration has successfully produced consecutive editions of the RUDN Africa Professional Short Course Scholarship Programme, providing members of the University's academic community with access to internationally recognized professional development opportunities.

The maiden edition, held in February 2025, offered specialized training in Entrepreneurial Journalism and Academic Publishing, attracting academic staff, postgraduate students, researchers, and professionals from diverse disciplines.

Building on this success, the second edition was organized in January 2026, featuring highly relevant courses on Digital Pedagogy for Higher Education and Implementing Ethical Artificial Intelligence in Academic Research and Writing.

Participants who successfully completed the programmes received internationally recognized professional certificates jointly issued by RUDN University and the Ministry of Education of the Russian Federation.

Across the two editions, approximately 200 academic staff members benefited from more than 20 hours of intensive, hands-on professional training, delivered at no financial cost to participants.

Beyond professional development, the successful implementation of these programmes demonstrates Fountain University's capacity to host high-quality international hybrid learning initiatives while strengthening its reputation as a trusted partner in global higher education.

The partnership continues to create opportunities for collaborative research, staff exchange, joint supervision of postgraduate students, curriculum development, and other forms of international academic cooperation.

name: Neuropsychiatric Hospital, Aro
shortDescription: Mental health partnership for clinical education and care research.
fullDescription:
Fountain University also maintains a strategic clinical training partnership with the Neuropsychiatric Hospital, Aro, Abeokuta—Nigeria's foremost specialist mental healthcare institution and the country's first purpose-built psychiatric hospital.

The collaboration provides specialised clinical training opportunities for students in the College of Basic Medical and Health Sciences, particularly those studying Physiotherapy, Medical Laboratory Science, and Public Health.

During their clinical postings, students receive supervised practical training that enables them to develop competencies in mental health care, rehabilitation, laboratory diagnostics, patient management, and public health practice while satisfying professional accreditation requirements.

Beyond student clinical training, the partnership promotes academic collaboration through seminars, workshops, conferences, and other professional development initiatives that enrich both teaching and research.

This collaboration reflects Fountain University's unwavering commitment to producing healthcare professionals who possess not only sound theoretical knowledge but also the practical skills, compassion, and professional competence required to provide quality healthcare services across diverse clinical settings.

name: Oyo State Hospital Management Board
shortDescription: Government healthcare partnership for nursing and allied health training.
fullDescription:
As part of its commitment to providing quality clinical education, Fountain University has established a strategic partnership with the Oyo State Hospitals Management Board, the government agency responsible for managing public healthcare facilities across Oyo State.

Through this collaboration, eligible Nursing Science students undertake clinical postings in government-owned hospitals under the Board's supervision, including the renowned Adeoyo Maternity Teaching Hospital and other accredited healthcare facilities.

The clinical rotations expose students to diverse healthcare settings, enabling them to gain practical experience in patient assessment, nursing care, maternal and child health, medical-surgical nursing, community health, and other specialized areas of practice. Working alongside experienced healthcare professionals allows students to develop the technical competence, critical thinking skills, and professional discipline expected of modern nursing practitioners.

This partnership significantly strengthens the University's efforts to bridge academic learning with real-world healthcare practice while producing highly skilled, compassionate, and practice-ready nursing graduates.

name: Osun State Hospital Management Board
shortDescription: State health partnership supporting clinical placements and research.
fullDescription: Osun State Hospital Management Board partners with Fountain University on clinical education, community health outreach, and patient care research.

name: Nigerian Private Universities Games (NPUG)
shortDescription: Sports collaboration that strengthens student athletics and competition.
fullDescription:
Recognizing that sporting excellence complements academic achievement, Fountain University is an active member of the Nigeria Private University Games Association (NPUGA), the body responsible for coordinating sporting competitions among private universities in Nigeria.

Through this membership, the University promotes physical fitness, healthy competition, leadership, teamwork, and holistic student development.

Fountain University participated in the 2024 NPUGA Championship hosted by Elizade University, Ilara-Mokin, competing in badminton, basketball, chess, scrabble, volleyball, and table tennis alongside private universities from across the country.

In the same year, the University hosted the NPUGA Council Meeting, welcoming delegates from over twenty-five private universities to its Osogbo campus. The University also participated actively in the 2025 NPUGA Games hosted by Babcock University, Ilishan-Remo, Ogun State.

These engagements reflect Fountain University's belief that excellence in education extends beyond the classroom to include sports, leadership development, wellness, and character formation.

name: Muslim Lecturers Association
shortDescription: Professional association partnership for academic development and networking.
fullDescription:
Fountain University's growing reputation as a centre of academic excellence has earned it the confidence of the Muslim Lecturers Association of Nigeria (MULAN), a professional association committed to promoting scholarship, research, leadership, and professional development among Muslim academics.

In recognition of the University's outstanding facilities, organizational capacity, and commitment to academic excellence, MULAN selected Fountain University as the host institution for its Third National Conference, scheduled to hold from 26–29 October 2026.

The announcement was formally made during a courtesy visit led by the Association's President, Professor AbdulWasiu Ajagbe, who commended the University for its remarkable achievements in academic development, staff capacity building, and successful hosting of major scholarly events.

Several members of Fountain University's academic staff actively participate in the Association's programmes, while the University has consistently supported staff participation in its national conferences.

Hosting the 2026 National Conference further affirms Fountain University's emergence as a preferred destination for national and international academic conferences, scholarly engagement, and intellectual discourse.

name: Society for Peace Studies and Practice (SPSP)
shortDescription: Professional partnership in peacebuilding and security studies that established the Institute for Peace and Security Studies (IPSS).
fullDescription:
In 2026, Fountain University established a strategic partnership with the Society for Peace Studies and Practice (SPSP), Nigeria's foremost professional body dedicated to advancing peacebuilding, conflict management, security studies, and sustainable development.

The collaboration reflects a shared commitment to promoting peace, security, justice, and social cohesion through education, research, professional training, and policy engagement. It seeks to develop highly skilled professionals capable of providing evidence-based solutions to complex national and global security challenges.

A major outcome of this landmark partnership is the establishment of the Institute for Peace and Security Studies (IPSS) at Fountain University.

The Institute serves as a centre of excellence for teaching, research, professional development, and policy dialogue in peace and security studies. It offers a wide range of academic and professional programmes, including certificate courses, postgraduate diplomas, Master's degrees, MPhil, and PhD programmes designed to prepare scholars, practitioners, policymakers, and security professionals for leadership roles in peacebuilding and conflict resolution.

Beyond academic programmes, the Institute promotes multidisciplinary research, policy advocacy, strategic dialogues, executive training, and stakeholder engagement on critical issues relating to peace, governance, conflict prevention, mediation, reconciliation, national security, and sustainable development.

The collaboration also creates opportunities for joint research projects, conferences, workshops, seminars, publications, and professional certification programmes involving academics, government institutions, civil society organizations, development partners, and security agencies.

Through this partnership, Fountain University is strengthening its contribution to national and regional peacebuilding efforts while expanding its research portfolio in security studies and conflict transformation. The initiative further positions the University as a leading centre for policy-relevant research, professional capacity building, and innovative solutions to contemporary peace and security challenges.

name: Chartered Institute of Local Government and Public Administration of Nigeria (CILGPAN)
shortDescription: Professional certification partnership linking academic learning with public administration practice.
fullDescription:
In 2026, Fountain University entered into a strategic partnership with the Chartered Institute of Local Government and Public Administration of Nigeria (CILGPAN) through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU). The collaboration reflects the University's commitment to integrating professional certification with academic learning and preparing graduates who possess both academic excellence and industry-relevant competencies.

The partnership is particularly beneficial to students in the College of Management and Social Sciences, providing opportunities for professional certification, capacity building, leadership development, knowledge exchange, and continuous professional education in public administration and local governance.

Through this collaboration, eligible students are admitted into the Institute as Student Members and are provided with clearly defined pathways to progress to the ranks of Associate, Member, and Fellow, depending on their academic and professional qualifications. This professional affiliation significantly enhances graduates' employability, leadership potential, professional competence, and understanding of contemporary issues in governance and public administration.

The collaboration recorded its first major milestone on 9 June 2026, when the Institute organized a professional development programme at Fountain University on the theme: "The Role of Public Administration in Enhancing Effective Service Delivery through the Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools."

The event featured distinguished public administrators, scholars, and professionals who examined the transformative role of Artificial Intelligence in modern public administration and governance.

In recognition of their outstanding contributions to higher education, leadership, and public service, the Vice-Chancellor, the Registrar, and seven other members of the University community were conferred with the prestigious Fellowship of the Institute.

The occasion also witnessed the formal induction of seventeen successful candidates into various professional membership categories of the Institute following the successful completion of its professional examinations.

This collaboration demonstrates Fountain University's unwavering commitment to producing graduates who combine academic excellence with recognized professional qualifications, thereby enhancing their competitiveness within Nigeria's public service and beyond.

name: NASFAT Missionary Institute
shortDescription: Faith-based partnership promoting intellectual engagement and scholarly dialogue on religion and society.
fullDescription:
Fountain University maintains a strategic partnership with the NASFAT Missionary Institute, reflecting the shared vision of both institutions to promote faith-based education, intellectual engagement, and societal transformation.

The collaboration culminated in the First International Conference, jointly organized from 20–23 November 2024, with Fountain University serving as co-host. The conference, themed "Navigating the Dynamics of Religion, Politics, Ethnicity and Youth for Peace and Development," attracted distinguished scholars, policymakers, religious leaders, and development experts from within and outside Nigeria.

The event featured Professor Is-haq Olanrewaju Oloyede, CON, Registrar of the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB), as the Keynote Speaker, while Alhaji (Dr.) Ayodeji AbdulWahid AbdulRauf, President of NASFAT Worldwide, served as the Chief Host.

Following the remarkable success of the maiden conference, both institutions resolved to institutionalize the conference as a biennial international event, creating a sustainable platform for scholarly dialogue, policy engagement, and collaborative research that addresses contemporary societal challenges.
